in_marathi.name: Bhoora
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhoora हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bhu’ which means ‘earth’ or ‘ground’. The name Bhoora is a masculine name and translates to ‘mountain’ or ‘large’. It is a name of power and strength, often used for boys in Hindu culture.
